entities.name: Ethernet PDU session type
entities.description: A PDU session type that uses EtherType as defined in IEEE Std 802.3. No MAC or IP address is allocated by the 5GCN to the UE for this session type.

entities.name: IPv4 PDU session type
entities.description: A PDU session type that uses IPv4 addressing. IP address allocation for this session type is described in subclause 6.2.4.

entities.name: IPv6 PDU session type
entities.description: A PDU session type that uses IPv6 addressing. IP address allocation for this session type is described in subclause 6.2.4.

entities.name: IPv4v6 PDU session type
entities.description: A PDU session type that supports both IPv4 and IPv6 addressing. IP address allocation for this session type is described in subclause 6.2.4.

entities.name: No address allocation for Ethernet PDU session
entities.description: Condition where neither a MAC nor an IP address is allocated by the 5GCN to the UE for Ethernet PDU session type.

relations.description: Ethernet PDU session type establishes the condition that no MAC or IP address is allocated by the 5GCN to the UE.
IPv4 PDU session type is defined along with IPv4v6 PDU session type in the same clause.
IPv6 PDU session type is defined along with IPv4v6 PDU session type in the same clause.
